context.axis: is the A ~ 150 crossover structural, or an accident of the calibration constant Q_beta?
context.answer: Its EXISTENCE is structural — an exponential and a line cross exactly once — but its LOCATION is not, moving 37-49 mass units per decade of scale. And no scale rescues the law: at the optimum (0.9483 MeV, only 1.21x the corpus value) the residual still spans 4.59 decades.
context.method: The optimum is computed in order to be REFUTED, which is the opposite of a fit: showing the best possible choice fails is stronger than showing one choice fails.
context.conclusion: B = Q_beta . Delta_tr has no regime of validity in A. Agreement at any particular A is a coincidence of the calibration.
context.scope: Scope-(a). Nothing touches the ALGEBRA — Delta_tr(Z,N) is closed-form, derived with zero fitted constants, and reproduces every measured value to 1e-35. What is refuted is the ansatz that binding is a constant times it. Whether some OTHER functional of the same operator works is untouched.
